title: The Agentic AI Stack in 2026
excerpt: What every founder needs to know about autonomous workflows that actually ship revenue.
content:
In 2026, agentic AI isn't a demo — it's a line item on the P&L. The teams winning right now share three traits...

1. They own their workflows

Off-the-shelf agents are a starting point. The compounding edge comes from custom orchestration.

2. They measure outcomes, not tokens

Cost per booked meeting. Cost per closed deal. Tokens are infrastructure, not strategy.

3. They invest in evaluation

Without evals, you're flying blind. The best teams ship evals before they ship features.
author: Integrit Team

title: RAG vs Fine-Tuning: A Practical Decision Tree
excerpt: When to retrieve, when to train, and when to do both.
content:
The short answer: start with RAG. The long answer is more interesting.

RAG when...

Knowledge changes daily, sources are structured, latency budget is forgiving.

Fine-tune when...

Style and format matter more than facts. Or when latency is tight.
author: Daniel Chen
